title: Personal Injuries Assessment Board Act 2003
verified_how: Fetched the eISB enacted page: title 'Personal Injuries Assessment Board Act 2003'. Directory entry says 'Act included in collectively cited Personal Injuries Resolution Board Acts'. The short title is unchanged and there is no whole-Act repeal.
notes: The Board was renamed the Personal Injuries Resolution Board by the Personal Injuries Resolution Board Act 2022, but this Act keeps its 2003 short title. Covers the assessment of personal injury claims.
